نبذة

Located in Bardon Central shopping centre above Bardon Bakehouse, Skin is a boutique beauty salon and paramedical skin clinic specialising in corrective skin treatments and non-invasive age management, brow shaping and skin tightening. With over 30 years of combined experience in spas, dermal clinics, beauty salons and cosmetic clinics, Hailey would like to invite you to experience their experience at Skin.

Best in Class

بناءً على 1,952 مراجعة رائعة من العملاء

Facials are a standout at Skin at Bardon, with clients praising the attentive care and soothing scalp, hand and foot massage that make each treatment deeply relaxing. The beauty therapists are also valued for their knowledgeable, personalised approach to skin care, while brow waxing and tinting deliver results clients are happy to return for, leaving each visit feeling considered and restorative.
